In OrderLoop, a refund needs lead approval when it is above 20,000 cents ($200.00). The constant `LEAD_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_CENTS = 20_000` is set in `backend/app/rules.py:10`. The check at `backend/app/rules.py:98` is `amount_cents > LEAD_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD_CENTS`, so a refund of exactly 20,000 cents does not need approval.

ANSWER: 20000
